title: Graduate Engineer - Roads & Highways
content_text:
Graduate Engineer - Roads & Highways
Location Sunshine Coast, QLD. Work Type Full time. Positions 1.
Join Calibre Transport team Sunshine Coast office.
The Calibre Graduate Program is a two-year integrated experience combining on-the-job learning, professional and technical training, mentoring and development opportunities.
Calibre is part of Calibre Group alongside Diona and Sevengen. Engineering, consulting, construction, project delivery across Australia and New Zealand.
Requirements: recently graduated with relevant tertiary qualifications in Civil Engineering and 0-1 years of experience. Keen interest in Calibre, excellent communication, commitment, willingness to learn, desire to work in a dynamic deadline-driven environment.
Apply with resume, covering letter and academic transcripts. Applications without those will not be considered.
Job no: YMY8M. Verified open 3 Oct 2026 via LiveHire.
apply_instructions: Apply on LiveHire with resume, covering letter and academic transcripts.
